title: ArcOrigin forge and stable workflow diversity 2026-10-17
assumptions: 2026-10-18 cross-tie revision: both grooming and saddling require leading to the care station, attaching two ropes and removing both before escort. Live reward policy reread 2026-10-18 MSK remains 20 vault/order and shared 100 orders/UUID/UTC-day. These added physical stages have no separate reward, permanent lead item or faster repeat route; before/after comparable-order amounts and caps below remain unchanged. Actual orders/hour after the longer chain remains unmeasured.
Unchanged live policy read on spawn 2026-10-17: 20 vault/completed order, shared cap 100 orders per UUID per UTC date, 600-second shift; full accrued shift paid exactly once.

Low/base/high: 5/20/50 participants, 0.25/1/2 active hours per day. 40/40/50 completed orders per hour are capacity assumptions, not observed timings; before/after amounts hold the same completed-order counts for a comparable-work comparison.

Before/after completed orders are 10/40/100 per player-day, capped across all side jobs. New multi-step chains have no per-step reward, item redemption, coins bonus or token reward. Actual completion cadence remains unmeasured; longer chains may lower realized hourly earnings.

Personal maximum in both revisions: 100 x 20 = 2000 vault/day. No global weekly budget exists for this flow; multi-account exposure remains linear in eligible UUID count. No new stacking or faster repeat path is introduced.

Tools/materials are session-bound temporary visuals and inventory markers, not exportable ordinary items. Cancellation, teleport/logout/reload must clean temporary supplies and release actor leases without accepting an unfinished order.

Existing EconomyShopGUI SELL remains an alternative flow until independently disabled. Planned SELL-to-contract transition and contract budgets are unchanged. These materials have no SELL or contract redemption path.

Read-only 168h ledger 2026-10-17: 12785 records/69170 operations/28 players, crossing-window records excluded. Vault minted 75426869.86869642, burned 4675559.949999997; tokens minted 54, burned 21. These aggregate totals are not representative side-job income; top-5 source view does not isolate Origin.
No prices, currency rates, speed buffs, XP or permanent entitlement changed. Disposable income and accumulation targets are intentionally not estimated from an incomplete top-source ledger.

flows.basis: Same completed orders and shared cap; changed physical stages do not create extra rewards
No token reward before or after
